Game Overview

Cute Box 2 is a adventure title where guide an adorable box through charming levels, collecting flowers and dodging colorful box foes and sneaky traps. Experience increasing challenges across eight delightful stages, pushing your platforming skills to their limits as you strive to reach the elusive red flag. Can you conquer every level?

How to Play

Cute Box 2 keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide an adorable box through charming levels, collecting flowers and dodging colorful box foes and sneaky traps. Experience increasing challenges across eight delightful stages, pushing your platforming skills to their limits as you strive to reach the elusive red flag. Can you conquer every level?
